measures.title: School Board of Pasco County Millage Election for Public School Students
measures.summary: Asks whether the School Board should continue levying an annual property tax (operating millage) of up to one mill from July 1, 2027, through June 30, 2031. The money would be used to recruit and retain teachers, bus drivers and non-administrator support employees and to enhance school safety, shared proportionately with public schools in the district as required by section 1011.71(9), Florida Statutes, with annual reporting to taxpayers.
measures.yesMeans: The School Board may continue the additional school operating property tax of up to one mill through June 30, 2031.
measures.noMeans: The additional school operating property tax is not continued beyond its current term.
